title: Participant label sequence

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is midpoint poster

slide_intent: Show a range of contributors in one repeated format so diverse roles feel equally eligible to participate.
strategic_value: Switching labels and fields can make Figma’s invitation feel broader than a single profession.
demonstration: A portrait sequence changes flat backgrounds, cursor types and role labels, including producer, architect, writer and other campaign characters.
practical_value: Keep a participant motif consistent while varying role, tool and color.

content_islands.name: Role card
content_islands.spec: Keep a compact tool-and-label pairing near the center of each portrait frame.

content_islands.name: Sequence changes
content_islands.spec: Change the background, label and tool together as the clip advances.

reference_purposes.Expression: Repeated tool-and-label cards cycle through contrasting colors and varied contributor roles.
reference_purposes.Intent: The source narrative describes inviting developers, producers, writers and others into the collaboration story.
